review.notes: The existing published Qualla gallery was reviewed first. Its eligible images depict the other campus, museum transport or exhibition objects. The science centre is reconstructed from native mapped outlines, 2024 numerical LiDAR measurements and the museum, designer and contractor’s written records.

estimates: The mapped footprint and sampled 2024 bare-ground and roof elevations constrain the overall profile. The location of the entrance, spacing of wall openings, southern threshold details and finish distribution are approximate.
The model uses the original Terrarium review terrain. The independent LINZ numbers constrain the roof skin and grade rise.
